sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. A single older male bust in a dark brown fedora with a broad black band and slanting brim; short wavy gray hair remains visible at the temples and sides, with gray-brown brows. The upper lip and chin are smooth, with no separate moustache or beard, and there are no glasses. The head turns slightly toward screen-right while the eyes look close to the viewer; closed lips and a reserved serious expression. Dark brown overcoat with a high turned-up collar and broad notched lapels, pale gray-white pointed shirt collar and burgundy-red tie. Retain the open coat neckline, raised collar, visible lapel seams and layered cloth contact around the neck. Chest and both shoulders cut by the lower/side canvas edges, hat entirely within the canvas. Soft warm light from upper screen-left, deeper shadows under the brim and at screen-right; dark gray-brown photographic painted backing/vignette fills the entire rectangle. No card frame, loose note, exterior cutout, medals or added writing. Exact156x210 original and full nearest4 detail actually viewed. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: tiny lapel stitch/slit marks and hat surface texture are visible only as small painted strokes, with no reliably readable emblem or lettering. Actual source alpha252..255 (252:8,253:18,254:150,255:32584); the painted backing remains visibly continuous under visible-alpha-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A single female bust with abundant dark brown hair swept upward and backward into a tall rounded waved/rolled style, with side sections gathered smoothly above the ears; dark softly arched brows. No hat, eyewear, moustache, beard or visible jewelry. Slight screen-left head turn and near-forward/leftward gaze, relaxed closed lips and a restrained neutral expression. Olive-brown wrap garment with broad ochre-gold edging forming an open V and crossing diagonally across the lower chest; retain the bare upper neck, overlapping golden border, smooth shoulder shape and darker diagonal cloth folds. The upper bust and shoulders are cropped at the lower/side edges, hair entirely within the canvas. Pale cream-gray painted backing with darker gray shading toward the lower sides, softly lit from upper screen-left with more shadow on the lower neck and screen-right. No frame, note, cutout, badges or text. Exact156x210 original and full nearest4 detail actually viewed. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: individual hair strands and faint garment surface weave cannot be resolved beyond the visible broad waves/folds; do not invent patterned embroidery. Actual source alpha255 throughout32760 pixels, with continuous painted backing under visible-alpha-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A single male military bust with short dark gray hair, grayer at the temples, combed in a side part and swept back with a slight wave; dark brows and a clearly visible thick gray moustache extending down at the mouth corners, with smooth chin/cheeks and no chin beard. No eyewear or hat. Head and eyes turn slightly upward toward screen-right, closed lips and a stern composed expression. Olive-gray high stand-collar tunic with a fine pale blue-gray inner neckline rim, closed front and one round gold/brass button below the collar; partial gold shoulder boards at both upper shoulder edges, more of the screen-left board visible. No distinct large collar badge or chest medal is visible. Preserve the stand collar shape, closure and neck contact. Upper chest and shoulders cropped by the lower/side edges. Pale warm gray-beige painted backing with slightly darker lower shading; soft highlight on forehead and screen-left cheek, shadow under chin and at screen-right. No separate card frame, note or exterior transparent cutout. Exact156x210 original and full nearest4 detail actually viewed. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: shoulder-board interior ornament is only tiny gold strokes, not a readable insignia/rank design. Actual source alpha249..255 (249:1,251:1,253:32,254:455,255:32271); continuous full painted backing is visible under visible-alpha-v1, without a missing internal area.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A single broad-faced male military bust with closely cropped receding dark hair and a thin short patch across the crown, heavy dark eyebrows, a thick gray moustache and a separate substantial gray chin beard/goatee; cheeks remain largely smooth. No hat or glasses. Near-front head with a slight turn toward screen-right, forward gaze, closed mouth and firm unsmiling expression. Olive-gray closed stand-collar tunic with a narrow dark blue-gray inner neckline rim, two rectangular gold collar tabs each bearing tiny raised dot-like ornaments, partial gold shoulder boards and one round brass/gold front button below the collar. Preserve the separate moustache/chin-beard shapes, collar tabs, broad neck contact and closed front. Shoulders/upper chest meet the lower and side crop. Pale warm cream-gray painted backing with darker gray lower shading; soft upper screen-left highlights and deeper screen-right/chin shadows. No loose note, card frame or exterior transparent cutout. Exact156x210 original and full nearest4 detail actually viewed. Evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1: the tiny raised collar-tab/shoulder-board ornament cannot be identified as exact symbols or counted with confidence beyond the visible gold shapes; no additional lettering or medals should be inferred. Actual source alpha249..255 (249:1,251:1,253:32,254:451,255:32275); full backing is visually continuous under visible-alpha-v1.
